title: A missing or behind Codex account setting does not move the account generation past the highest saved-thread stamp
outcome: After the account setting file is lost or rolled back, no Codex thread saved under an earlier account is silently restarted after a lost rollout.
acceptance: When termal.codex-account.json is missing, or records a generation below a saved thread's stamp, boot restore sets the generation past the highest stamp, as it already does for an unreadable file, shown by a behaviour test.
A setting whose generation is at or above every stamp keeps its own generation.
